terms.theme: Consolidation programme and baseline assessment; Celebrating birthdays; Getting around

topics.name: Consolidation and baseline assessment: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Theme: Consolidation programme and baseline assessment
More complex greetings each week (e.g. 'Good morning! How are you?' 'I am fine thanks'; 'How do you feel today?'; 'Where do you live?'; 'What is your name?'; 'What is the day today?')
Song 'Names, names are not the same'; claps the syllables in own name
Classroom routines: ability groups and attention getters ('1-2-3 eyes on me'; 'If you can hear me clap once')
Concept words through actions: same, different, more, fewer; favourite-colour class graph
Baseline assessment (weeks 1-3): points to objects in DBE Workbook 1 p.2, identifies an object from an oral description, responds to greetings and simple instructions

topics.name: Consolidation and baseline assessment: Reading (Shared Reading)
subtopics: Weeks 1-4: baseline comprehension activities
Weeks 5-6: consolidation - builds vocabulary, revises sight words, comprehension activities

topics.name: Consolidation and baseline assessment: Reading (Group Guided Reading)
subtopics: Week 1: baseline oral reading fluency to set reading groups
Weeks 2-4: teacher hears each learner read (easier, average and harder texts; DBE Workbook or EGRA) and sorts the class into 5 reading groups
Weeks 5-6: teaches Group Guided Reading routines (monitors, reading-book monitors, toilet pass, working on worksheets independently)

topics.name: Consolidation and baseline assessment: Phonics
subtopics: Week 1: baseline assessment on Grade 1 phonics
Week 2: identifies all single letter sounds; /j/ (jam, jab, job)
Week 3: distinguishes single sounds aurally; /r/ (red, rob, run, rat)
Week 4: distinguishes initial, middle and end sounds; /w/ (wet, wall, win, wig)
Week 5: -at words (cat, mat, fat, sat); Week 6: -an words (pan, fan, can, van); segment, blend and write the words

topics.name: Consolidation and baseline assessment: Writing
subtopics: Week 1: baseline - language structures and creative writing
Week 2: draws self and writes two sentences about self (teacher models)
Week 3: draws feelings on the first day of school
Week 4: lists animals; draws favourite animal and writes two sentences
Week 5: draws own home and writes two sentences; Week 6: draws best friend and writes two sentences

topics.name: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Theme: Celebrating birthdays

Songs: 'Happy birthday to you'; 'One little girl went out to play' (counting)

Vocabulary e.g. birthday, celebrate, candle, present, unwrap, surprise, party, wish, gift, invitation
Sight words: sad, saw, sit, friends, very; what, doing, play, sleep, happy

sba: Baseline assessment (observation checklist, weeks 1-6): points to named objects, identifies an object from an oral description, responds to greetings and instructions; beginning sounds, rhyming words, segmenting sentences, clapping syllables; answers questions about a story, recognises 20-30 familiar words; completes a writing frame, writes a simple list

Reading oral (weeks 7-8; rubric): answers simple recall questions about a Shared Reading story
Writing (weeks 7-9; rubric out of 32): draws a picture for a story and writes two sentences (sentences, capitalisation, punctuation, spacing, words, vowels, sight words, ideas)
